name: Mountain run vertical intervals 55
description: Five four-minute efforts at the steepest grade the W1 offers: vertical-kilometre style climbing strength. Needs the console in running mode and --running-mode.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog or brisk walk, relaxed shoulders.

steps.name: Steep effort
steps.notes: RPE 8-9. Controlled; fast feet, strong arms.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Walk it off; let the breathing settle.
